papers.title: DNA: Unlocking Depth Scaling in CTR Models
papers.abstract: Long user behavior sequences are among the strongest signals for click-through rate (CTR) prediction. Cross-attention makes these sequences practical for industrial ranking by keeping compute linear in sequence length. Yet the gains from stacking cross-attention layers taper off: on Taobao search, growing a cross-attention stack from 16 to 28 layers adds only 0.02 percentage points (pt) of AUC. We argue that the key-value side is the bottleneck. Each layer projects the same behavior sequence into keys and values, so adding depth gives the model more reads of a fixed sequence. We propose DNA (Dual-stream Nexus Attention), which lets the sequence itself evolve with depth. At each layer, the request representation (the search query, user features and scene) first reads the sequence. Each behavior token then attends to the updated request representation and uses what it reads to update itself, so the next layer reads a sequence shaped by the current request. The update runs once per request, all candidates share the resulting sequence, and both the reads and the update keep linear complexity in sequence length. At comparable forward FLOPs, DNA improves AUC over cross-attention stacks by 0.08 to 0.26 pt and keeps improving in the depth range where those stacks level off. DNA-4 is deployed in Taobao search. In an online A/B test against the production model, it improves CTR by 0.8% and GMV by 0.5%.
papers.summary: 每层先用用户行为更新请求表示，再用请求更新行为序列，多个候选共享计算。
papers.reason: 适合测试长序列精排加深后的收益；线上实验只验证了整体模型。

explanation.problem: 长行为序列的交叉注意力模型越堆越深却几乎不再涨点，需要弄清瓶颈并让加深继续有收益。
explanation.method: 把输入分成三路：候选特征、请求特征（查询词、用户与场景）和行为序列。每层先让候选和请求两路分别读取当前序列；再用刚更新的请求表示作为键值、每个行为token作为查询，反向更新序列本身，供下一层读取。更新只依赖请求、与候选无关，因此每个请求算一次、所有候选共享，注意力开销随序列长度线性增长。最后一层只读不更新，候选表示与请求表示合并后输出点击预测。
explanation.application: 推测：电商精排可把现有交叉注意力堆叠改为请求级序列更新，在候选数上千时按请求摊销更新成本；多行为序列组可借共享请求表示互通信息而无需合并时间线。
explanation.caveat: 线上A/B是DNA-4整体替换生产模型的结果，未单独验证更新模块的贡献，且仅淘宝搜索一个场景、单日日志离线评估。

papers.title: MARS Technical Report
papers.abstract: Modern industrial recommender systems use multi-stage cascades--retrieval, pre-ranking, ranking, and re-ranking--to narrow millions of candidates to a personalized list. While each stage deploys sophisticated models, pipeline-level decisions on channel activation, quotas, model selection, and score fusion remain engineer-tuned and user-agnostic within each scenario. This report presents MARS (Multi-stage Agentic Recommendation System), extending personalization from individual-stage predictions to full pipeline orchestration. A near-line agent built on fine-tuned Qwen3-0.6B generates per-user configurations--a seven-dimensional action covering pipeline mode, retrieval quotas, model selection, fusion weights, and reranker settings--from a constrained action space. Configurations are validated, cached, and consumed asynchronously; the cascade never waits for LLM inference. Schema checks, fallbacks, and a kill switch ensure serving safety. The policy is trained in three stages: Confidence-aware SFT distills schema-valid generation from a teacher model; Format-Anchored Preference Optimization (FAPO) learns action preferences via ActionMask with posterior weighting; Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) refines the policy through Sandbox replay with a frozen reward model, without exposing exploratory actions to live traffic. Two-week A/B tests across five Taobao scenarios with over ten million daily users show positive gains on all key metrics. The largest reach +5.22% V2P and +7.34% GMV, with positive CTR lifts on both click surfaces. About 20% of requests use a lightweight Minimal mode, and deployment shows 12 ms lower mean serving latency versus production.
papers.summary: 用小语言模型提前为用户生成召回、融合和重排配置，线上请求直接读缓存。
papers.reason: 可借鉴近线策略编排和回退设计；各阶段对整体收益的贡献仍不清楚。

explanation.problem: 整条推荐流水线的通道开关、配额、模型选择和融合权重目前由工程师统一调好、所有用户共用一套，无法随用户意图和请求上下文变化。
explanation.method: 把用户画像、跨场景行为序列和场景上下文拼成提示，输入微调的小语言模型，输出一份七维结构化配置（流水线模式、召回通道子集与各通道配额、CTR/CVR模型、各阶段融合权重、重排器设置），参数只在生产默认值附近有界扰动。配置先做格式与合法性校验，通过后原子写入按用户和场景为键的版本化缓存；在线请求只读最新有效缓存，失败或过期则回退到原有生产配置。策略训练分三步：先用大模型教师蒸馏出合法结构化输出并按执行效果筛选，再做只比较动作字段差异的偏好优化，最后在沙盒回放中用冻结的奖励模型做组相对策略优化。
explanation.application: 推测：电商推荐可借鉴其“近线生成配置、在线只读缓存”的解耦方式，把召回通道配额、多目标融合权重、是否跳过预排/重排等做成按用户或请求可调的受限动作空间，并用沙盒回放+学习奖励模型做离线策略迭代，避免探索流量风险；其结构化动作掩码偏好优化也可迁移到其他结构化决策生成任务。
explanation.caveat: 线上收益是整条编排策略的端到端结果，未单独验证各编排维度贡献；沙盒回放与学习奖励模型均为近似，公式化业务分是匹配代理而非因果响应。

papers.title: Learning Generative Ranking Policies for Whole-Page Optimization
papers.abstract: A recommendation page is consumed as a whole: the items on it compete for attention and complement one another, so the best page is not simply the individually best items placed side by side. We study whole-page optimization, which selects and orders the items on a page jointly to maximize the score of the page. The number of possible pages grows combinatorially, so good pages must be generated rather than enumerated. Some generative re-ranking methods use the same page-level training signal for every choice in a sampled page. Others imitate target pages built before training, which remain largely fixed as the generator improves. We address both limitations with one local page-level objective, which repeatedly moves the current generator toward pages with higher score. This objective splits exactly into one training target per position, and each target compares candidates at the same partial page by the scores of the complete pages they lead to. Every position therefore learns to choose the item that is better for the whole page, rather than the item that looks best on its own. We call this procedure whole-page policy improvement. On two public datasets, KuaiRand-1K and RL4RS-SeqSlate, which cover multi-objective item selection and constrained ordering, and on an industrial dataset of logged pages, our method outperforms the evaluated generative re-ranking baselines. On a synthetic benchmark with a known optimal page, it also comes closest to the optimum, showing that its improvements come from better whole-page decisions.
papers.title_zh: 学习整页优化的生成式排序策略
papers.summary: 为每个候选补全整页，用整页得分训练生成器逐个位置选商品。
papers.reason: 适合尝试把整页价值用于重排训练；目前只有离线和仿真结果。

explanation.problem: 一页推荐里商品互相抢注意力又互相补充，逐个挑最好的再拼起来并不是最好的整页，需要联合选择与排序。
explanation.method: 每轮先用当前生成器采样出若干页面并记录每个位置之前的部分页；在每个部分页上，把每个候选放到下一位、让当前生成器补完剩余位置，用整页评估器给补全页打分；再按分数对当前候选概率做指数重加权并归一化，得到该位置的训练目标，用交叉熵把生成器拟合到这些目标，更新后的生成器再构造下一轮数据。
explanation.application: 推测：电商推荐可把精排或重排的整页价值模型当作固定评估器，用该流程训练生成式重排器，把曝光、点击、加购等目标合成整页分数，并复用其按位置重加权的目标构造来替代固定教师蒸馏。
explanation.caveat: 所有收益均为离线评估器或仿真打分，无线上A/B，工业数据集仅来自单日训练与随后三天测试的日志回放。

papers.title: X-split Argus: Learning Reusable History Tokens for Efficient CTR Prediction
papers.abstract: Accurate click-through rate (CTR) prediction depends on user representations that capture both persistent preferences and recent intent, yet processing extensive behavioral histories for every ranking request is costly under production compute and latency constraints. We present X-split ARGUS, a framework for ad ranking whose history compressor and online ranker are trained end to end. The compressor encodes past interactions into a compact set of tokens that are computed offline and reused across candidates, while the online ranker scores ads through cross-attention to these tokens and representations of recent events. Training combines an autoregressive loss for click feedback with distillation of candidate-specific click logits from a larger teacher that scores each candidate using the uncompressed history. The number of compressed history tokens and the length of recent history can be adjusted to fit serving compute and latency budgets. Offline evaluation shows a 0.81% relative reduction in normalized entropy (NE) compared with the production baseline. Deployment in a large-scale real-time bidding system increases online inference cost by 15% relative to the production baseline. An online A/B test against this baseline yields relative gains of 4.65% in a business metric reflecting the monetary value of conversions generated for advertisers and 2.96% in clicks.

explanation.problem: 每次排序请求都重新编码用户很长的行为历史太贵，想在有限算力和延迟内既用上长历史又保留候选相关的打分能力。
explanation.method: 先用一个因果Transformer把用户历史压成少量与候选无关的摘要token，离线算好缓存复用；线上只对最近若干条原始事件做一次编码，所有候选共享；候选广告经编码后作为查询，对摘要token和近期状态做交叉注意力得到点击预测；训练时同时用真实点击和更大教师模型（用未压缩全历史）的点击logit做蒸馏，让压缩器学会保留有用信息。
explanation.application: 推测：电商精排可把用户长期行为离线压缩成少量token缓存，线上只编码最近行为并对候选做交叉注意力，同时用全历史大模型蒸馏小模型，以在延迟预算内扩展历史长度。
explanation.caveat: 线上收益来自整体方案，未单独验证压缩器、蒸馏、平滑等各模块的贡献；离线仅单一内部数据集，且机构与数据集归属原文未说明。

papers.title_zh: X-split Argus：学习可复用的历史Token以实现高效CTR预测
papers.summary: 离线把用户长历史压成可复用的表示，线上结合近期行为给候选广告打分。
papers.reason: 适合评估长序列精排的成本收益；在线实验中同等流量多用了15%的 GPU。

evidence.finding: 线上A/B为7天、实验组与对照组各占该广告面6%流量，相对生产基线ACV提升4.65%、点击数提升2.96%，且需多用15%同型号在线GPU。

papers.title: Lost in the Funnel: Selection-Induced Miscalibration in Ranking and Decision Systems
papers.abstract: Modern ranking and decision systems combine components with divergent objectives, and scores calibrated at the model boundary are used as calibrated probabilities throughout the funnel, across filtering, reranking, business-rule enforcement, and auctions. Yet calibration is typically validated only where the score is produced, so its breakdown where the score is used is routinely overlooked. We ask when calibration survives this selection, how inherited error differs from selection effects, and what can fail for a perfectly calibrated score at a component boundary. We study these questions through a boundary-wise diagnostic framework of residual identities. We target rubric-judged relevance rather than presentation-dependent metrics such as CTR, so calibration is measurable at every funnel layer of interest. We first present an industry-wide case study that applies our diagnosis to settings where calibration deteriorates at decision time, tracing the degradation to selection rather than model error. This diagnosis motivates Funnel-Aware Recalibration (FAR): post-hoc, selection-policy-aware recalibration at the boundary where scores drive decisions. In a live two-region production A/B test, FAR cuts decision-time expected calibration error (ECE) by 60-80% and improves auction efficiency. We further adapt two public datasets to simulate industry settings, providing additional evidence for the mechanism. We plan to release the adapted datasets and their generation pipeline to support further research. Finally, we distill these findings into practical operating principles for calibrating multi-stage scoring systems.

explanation.problem: 模型输出时校准良好的分数，经过过滤、重排、竞价等层层筛选后，在真正做决策的地方可能已经系统性偏了。
explanation.method: 把每个筛选边界前后的带标签样本按分数分箱，用残差恒等式把幸存者偏差拆成三部分：上游带来的继承误差、各分数箱占比变化造成的构成偏移、以及箱内被筛选者结果系统性偏离箱均值造成的残差偏移。诊断显示偏差主要来自第三项后，就在分数进入下游决策的那个边界上，用该策略实际保留下来的样本重新拟合一个单调校准映射，模型和服务规则都不动，并定期重拟合。
explanation.application: 推测：电商推荐可在粗排到精排、精排到重排/混排、以及业务规则过滤后的每个边界做同样诊断，用曝光前的人工或规则相关性标签在幸存者上重校准分数，再用于阈值和排序融合。
explanation.caveat: 线上证据仅来自微软广告一个平台的两地区A/B，标签是广告相关性判定而非点击或转化，公开数据部分为仿真重放而非真实线上验证。

papers.title_zh: 迷失在漏斗中：排序与决策系统中的选择诱导校准偏差
papers.summary: 沿排序漏斗检查分数偏差，并在拍卖真正使用分数的位置重新校准。
papers.reason: 可对照精排输出和曝光样本的校准曲线；广告实验中 RPM 变化未达显著。

evidence.finding: 线上两地区A/B显示FAR把决策时ECE降低60–71%，同时广告覆盖下降、CTR上升、RPM无显著变化，属于线上对照实验证据。

papers.title: PEETS: Preference-aware Embeddings with Explicit Tree Structure for Auxiliary Product Bundling
papers.abstract: Auxiliary products such as flight protection and flexible-change services are recommended alongside primary travel purchases. This setting creates a granularity ambiguity: SKUs within one product type share semantics but differ in price and coverage, while rejecting one offer does not imply disinterest in the entire type. We present \textbf{PEETS} (\textbf{P}reference-aware \textbf{E}mbeddings with \textbf{E}xplicit \textbf{T}ree \textbf{S}tructure), a training-time framework for auxiliary product bundling. PEETS regularizes an existing click--conversion predictor through two conditional comparisons. Hierarchical Contrastive Loss uses the pair's common ancestor as a reference; Negative Contrastive Loss conditions structural sampling and comparison shifts on logged rejection events. Both act on shared SKU representations during training. This separates catalog relatedness from individual preference supervision and leaves the predictive serving path intact. PEETS achieves 78.20\% AUC, exceeding TWIN V2 by 0.90 percentage points and the matched base model by 1.15 points. In a 14-day online evaluation, gross auxiliary GMV per exposed user-day improves by 8.20\% over Policies, 3.06\% over Base, and 0.84\% over TWIN V2, with all three user-bootstrap 95\% intervals above zero. Bundling rate is 0.51 points below Policies. The cancellation interval's upper limit exceeds the prespecified margin. PEETS adds no auxiliary-loss computation to serving and records 42.1~ms p95 latency, compared with 42.0~ms for Base.

explanation.problem: 同一类辅助产品下不同SKU价格和保障范围差异大，用户拒绝某个报价不等于不喜欢整类产品，模型需要区分“目录相关”和“个人偏好”。
explanation.method: 先把SKU按品类和价格分位挂到一棵树上，每个节点有可训练嵌入。训练时做两类对比：同类同祖先的SKU互为正样本、跨类为负样本；对用户显式拒绝的SKU，用同层其他桶作参照，把被拒桶的统计量作为平移量加到比较双方上。两个辅助损失只更新共享SKU嵌入，线上仍用原来的点击和购买双头打分。
explanation.application: 推测可迁移到电商搭售、加购推荐和保险等辅助品精排：用类目-价格树构造对比正负样本，并把“删除/替换”等显式拒绝日志作为条件信号；需先确认自身日志有可区分的拒绝事件和稳定的类目价格层级。
explanation.caveat: 线上收益来自整体模型对比，未单独验证层级树与拒绝条件各自的线上贡献；取消率非劣性未通过，且数据仅来自单一旅行场景。

papers.title_zh: PEETS：面向辅助产品搭售的偏好感知嵌入与显式树结构
papers.summary: 训练时用商品层级和用户明确拒绝的搭售商品改进表示，线上沿用原有打分流程。
papers.reason: 可测试拒绝信号对搭售价值预估的帮助；线上取消率未通过非劣性检验。

evidence.finding: 该页报告14天用户级随机线上实验：PEETS每曝光用户日GMV比Policies高8.20%、比Base高3.06%、比TWIN V2高0.84%，三个用户bootstrap区间均不含零，但取消率区间上限超过预设边际。

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

papers.title: IntentGR: Enhancing Intent for End-to-End Personalized Generative Retrieval in Search
papers.abstract: Personalized generative retrieval in search should jointly satisfy the user's immediate search intent and long-term preference. Recent end-to-end approaches, primarily explored in recommendation, unify item tokenization and sequence generation within a single model, allowing semantic identifiers (SIDs) to be optimized toward the downstream generation objective. However, these methods often treat the query merely as an input feature, without explicitly leveraging it to guide either identifier learning or sequence generation. This leaves intent guidance weak in both the tokenization and the generation stage, causing generated semantic identifiers to drift toward high-frequency token patterns rather than the current search intent. In this work, we find that incorporating additional query-related evidence into the framework of end-to-end generative retrieval is important. Based on this finding, we propose IntentGR, an intent-enhanced end-to-end framework that strengthens query semantics at four complementary stages of the retrieval pipeline. Query-Aware Semantic Behavior Representation (QBR) introduces query-level behavioral evidence as a new input signal; Query-Semantic Alignment (QSA), Long-Tail Query Enrichment (LQE), and Query-conditioned Attention Modulation (QAM) then serve as integration mechanisms at the optimization, training-distribution, and decoding stages to fully exploit this evidence. Experiments on the public AOL4PS benchmark and AE, a large-scale industrial e-commerce dataset, show that IntentGR improves Recall@10 by 8.11% and 11.96% over the strongest baseline, with strong gains on long-tail queries. These results suggest that enriched query-related input evidence, together with effective integration mechanisms, is beneficial for building intent-aware end-to-end generative search systems.

explanation.problem: 个性化搜索里，生成式检索模型容易忽略当前查询意图，生成的物品标识偏向高频模式，长尾查询尤其差。
explanation.method: 先把同一查询下其他用户的历史点击序列作为新输入，与用户自身历史一起编码；再用对比学习把查询表示与目标物品的重构表示对齐，让分词器和生成器共享查询语义目标；接着对低频查询重复采样并做查询改写，平衡训练分布；最后在解码时把查询向量融合进上下文各位置，强化查询对生成标识的引导。
explanation.application: 推测可把查询级协同点击序列作为精排/生成式重排的额外输入特征，并用查询-物品对比损失约束语义标识学习；长尾查询重采样与改写可迁移到搜索训练数据构造。
explanation.caveat: 全部为离线数据集评测，无线上A/B或仿真，四模块增益主要来自消融累加，未单独验证各模块在真实流量下的独立贡献。

papers.title_zh: IntentGR：面向搜索端到端个性化生成式检索的意图增强
papers.summary: 提出IntentGR，在输入、优化、训练分布和解码四个阶段强化查询意图，联合优化RQ-VAE物品分词器与生成式检索器。在AOL4PS和AliExpress工业数据集上，Recall@10较最强基线ETEGRec-Q分别提升8.11%和11.96%，长尾查询增益更大；证据限于离线评测，无线上A/B。
papers.reason: 对做生成式重排/检索的工程师，它给出查询级行为序列、查询-物品对比对齐、长尾查询增强和解码注意力调制四个可拆解模块，但只有离线指标、无线上验证。

evidence.finding: 表2离线对比显示IntentGR在AOL4PS和AE上Recall@10分别为77.99%和34.36%，高于最强基线ETEGRec-Q的69.88%和22.40%，但仅为离线评测，无线上A/B。

papers.title: COTTI: Contrastive Training and Time-Aware Inference for Robust Industrial Recommendation under Promotional Drift
papers.abstract: Promotional events shift traffic composition, purchase behavior, and the scale of conversion probabilities on different time horizons. We present \textbf{COTTI} (\textbf{CO}ntrastive \textbf{T}raining and \textbf{T}ime-aware \textbf{I}nference), an industrial recommendation framework that separates historical representation learning from event-time score adjustment. Cross-Period Contrastive Alignment (CPC) regularizes paired histories of the same user with adaptive consistency weights. Active Re-weighting (RW) controls the influence of promotional examples through historical-interest distance. Adaptive Boundary Alignment (ABA) combines stochastic prediction variability with a temporal event kernel to adjust logits while keeping predictor parameters fixed. We analyze the weighted objective and bound ABA-induced probability and ranking changes. On Fliggy data, COTTI attains an offline AUC of 0.8127, compared with 0.8101 for TEN and 0.8123 for TEN with ABA. Cross-category analysis reveals improved discrimination alongside declines in paid-item recall for novel categories. End-to-end measurements give a p99 latency of 38.9\,ms and throughput of 14,700 requests/s; enabling ABA adds 2.2\,ms to p99. A ten-day online experiment against the serving HDR model yields relative gains of 3.14\% in conversion rate and 2.68\% in revenue per mille. Together, these results characterize the trade-off between aggregate prediction, novel-category discovery, and serving cost in promotional recommendation.

explanation.problem: 大促期间用户行为和转化率分布突变，平时训练的模型反应太慢，排序和转化率估计会失准。
explanation.method: 先用同一用户平时与促销期的两段历史做对比学习，让表示保持一定一致，并按两段差异自适应调弱对齐强度；再按促销样本与用户历史兴趣的距离给训练样本加权，离历史越远权重越低；最后在参数冻结的推理阶段，用已公布的活动时间核和预测头多次随机前向得到的方差，对转化logit做单向抬升校正。
explanation.application: 推测可把训练期历史一致性正则与推理期事件感知分数校正拆开落地，在电商大促精排中作为独立于主模型的校准层试验，并用新品类召回和延迟做约束。
explanation.caveat: 线上仅与HDR单基线对比十天，未报告置信区间、分流方式和聚合权重，全量上线轨迹无同期对照。

papers.title_zh: COTTI：面向促销漂移下鲁棒工业推荐的对比训练与时间感知推理
papers.summary: 提出COTTI框架，用跨周期对比对齐、按历史距离重加权促销样本、以及推理期基于事件时间核与预测方差的logit校正三部分应对促销期分布漂移。Fliggy离线AUC 0.8127略高于TEN的0.8101，但TEN加ABA后差距仅0.0004；十天线上A/B相对HDR提升CVR 3.14%、RPM 2.68%，同时新品类付费召回下降、p99延迟增加2.2ms。
papers.reason: 三组件分工清晰、消融与校准对照较完整，可借鉴其训练期正则与推理期分数校正分离的思路；但增益幅度小、线上仅对HDR单基线且无置信区间，新品类召回有损。

evidence.finding: 离线消融显示去掉CPC、RW、ABA后AUC分别降至0.8082、0.8051、0.8102，但均为点估计且未分离组件交互。

institutions: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

papers.title: From Relevance to Utility: Rubric Alignment in Yuanbao Search
papers.abstract: Agentic search demands that a search engine move beyond per document relevance ranking to assemble document sets optimized for downstream LLM reasoning. Prior work addresses this either by improving individual pipeline stages in isolation or by applying RL based selection on top of relevance trained upstream modules, leaving the full stack unaligned to utility for reasoning. We propose rubric aligned search, a framework that unifies the traditional search pipeline under a single supervision surface. For each query, we derive a rubric from coarse to fine, specifying weighted positive criteria that the document set must satisfy and negative criteria that it must avoid. From this rubric we derive two training signals. First, a lightweight labeler distills rubric grounded judgments into per document utility labels, which supervise a contrastive dual encoder for retrieval and a multi task ranker trained with four rubric aligned scoring heads. Second, a rubric conditioned evaluator produces a set level reward that drives a dual branch RL selector, combining GRPO with best rollout distillation to resolve credit assignment in subset optimization. Deployed in Yuanbao Search, the pipeline improves end to end answer quality by 8.52% over the online production baseline.

explanation.problem: 智能搜索里LLM只看一小撮文档作答，传统按单文档相关性排序挑出的文档集合未必能让答案更好。
explanation.method: 先为每个查询自动生成由粗到细的评分标准，列出必须覆盖的加权要点和必须避免的缺陷；再用大模型按标准给文档打分，蒸馏成轻量标注器，为海量查询-文档对产出效用等级，用来训练召回双塔和排序模型；最后用同一标准给候选文档子集打分作为奖励，用强化学习训练选择器，并用组内最佳结果做蒸馏缓解奖励稀疏。
explanation.application: 推测可把评分标准思路迁移到电商精排与生成式重排：用大模型按商品属性要点蒸馏逐商品效用标签，再对最终展示集合做集合级奖励训练。
explanation.caveat: 线上证据仅为14天5%流量的GSB人工对比，未报告留存或成交等业务指标，各模块增益存在重叠。

papers.title_zh: 从相关性到效用：元宝搜索中的评分标准对齐
papers.summary: 提出以查询级评分标准（加权正/负准则）作为统一监督信号，蒸馏出逐文档效用标签训练检索与排序，并用GRPO加最佳轨迹蒸馏训练集合选择器。线上A/B显示各组件独立增益，全链路答案质量GSB提升8.52%。
papers.reason: 对做生成式重排与集合级效用建模的推荐工程师有直接参考价值，但线上仅报告GSB人工评测，缺少留存等业务指标。

evidence.finding: 线上A/B中三个组件各自独立加入生产基线均显著提升答案GSB，全链路净增益8.52%，但各组件增益之和9.16%高于净增益，说明收益存在重叠。

institutions: School of Cyber Science and Engineering, Wuhan University
